note: Not wired into the app yet. Entries must remain proposed until runtime implementation and tests are complete.

features.name: Smart Performance Advisor
features.summary: Recommendations based on available device, RAM, renderer, version, thermal and battery signals.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends existing heap defaults; never silently changes saved RAM or renderer settings.

features.name: Server Status Monitor
features.summary: Add, edit, remove and refresh servers; show online state, MOTD, icon, player count and latency.
features.duplicatePolicy: Dedicated server-status page; not a duplicate of instance/profile management.

features.name: Custom Theme Studio
features.summary: Preview, apply, switch, import and uninstall custom launcher themes.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends the built-in VoidCraft theme; never removes the default theme.

features.name: Live Performance HUD
features.summary: Show supported in-game FPS, frame-time, memory and runtime metrics.
features.duplicatePolicy: Only show metrics genuinely exposed by the device/runtime.

features.name: Scheduled World Backup Automation
features.summary: Schedule backups, set retention limits and browse backup history.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends current manual ZIP backup/verify/restore; reuse all existing safety checks.

features.name: Advanced Instance Toolkit
features.summary: Advanced cloning, icons, tags, favorites, search, sorting and notes where not already supported.
features.duplicatePolicy: Show only missing workflows; reuse the existing profile format.

features.name: VoidCraft Social
features.summary: Username profile, friend requests/removal, block/report, privacy settings and private chat.
features.duplicatePolicy: Requires separate secure backend and consent; Minecraft sign-in alone does not create a social account.

features.name: Community World Gallery
features.summary: Browse reviewed community worlds with creator/license/version metadata and import after confirmation.
features.duplicatePolicy: Use VoidCraft reviewed registry or creator-provided URLs; no Modrinth/CurseForge API dependency.

features.name: Resource Pack Previewer
features.summary: Preview pack metadata/screenshots, compare details and inspect supported versions.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends existing pack folder/toggle; do not claim a live preview unless implemented.

features.name: Download Queue Enhancer
features.summary: Unified supported-download status, history, retry/cancel and integrity indicators.
features.duplicatePolicy: Reuse the existing downloader; never fake pause/resume or add a parallel downloader.

features.name: Shader Compatibility Checker
features.summary: Compare shader metadata with Minecraft version, renderer and known device requirements.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends shader folder/toggle; report evidence and uncertainty rather than guarantees.

features.name: Mod Compatibility Checker
features.summary: Inspect dependency metadata, version constraints, duplicates and likely conflicts before launch.
features.duplicatePolicy: Never delete or disable files automatically; do not rely on filenames alone.

features.name: Quick Settings Profiles
features.summary: Save and switch named performance/battery settings with a preview before applying.
features.duplicatePolicy: Reuse safe preference allowlists; exclude tokens, free-form Java arguments and user world data.

features.name: Enhanced Crash Log Analyzer
features.summary: Richer crash signatures, explanations and a user-reviewed redacted diagnostic report.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends existing heuristic log diagnosis; no silent log uploads.

features.name: Playtime Tracker
features.summary: Track local session length, per-instance totals and recent sessions.
features.duplicatePolicy: Local-only by default; no cloud upload by default.

features.name: Screenshot Gallery Plus
features.summary: Thumbnail gallery, sorting, favorites and explicit user-initiated sharing.
features.duplicatePolicy: Extends existing Screenshots folder shortcut; original files stay unchanged by default.

features.name: Modpack Update Watcher
features.summary: Track compatible updates through signed VoidCraft manifests or trusted creator feeds.
features.duplicatePolicy: No Modrinth/CurseForge API calls for the Feature Store; backup before applying changes.

features.name: Accessibility Enhancements
features.summary: Extra high contrast, larger text/tap targets, reduced motion and focus indicators.
features.duplicatePolicy: Adds only options not already offered by Android/system accessibility or core UI.

features.name: Storage Cleaner
features.summary: Review disposable temporary files, stale store downloads and allowlisted caches.
features.duplicatePolicy: Never delete worlds, backups, profiles, accounts, configs, mods, runtimes, native libraries or game assets.

storeShell.name: Community Feature Showcase
storeShell.description: Flat browse/search page, creator/review information, compatibility and permission details, install/update/uninstall states, and an installed-features list. Every installed feature opens its own page.
storeShell.note: Part of the Store shell, not a separately installable add-on. No categories.

keepBuiltIn: Java runtime, native libraries, engine, renderer/runtime integration and essential launch pipeline
Minecraft version metadata, client, library and asset downloads
integrationRules: Optional add-ons call supported launcher services; they do not replace core internals.
Installation, update, failure, rollback and uninstall must preserve worlds and existing user data.
An item already implemented in core may only appear as an add-on when it adds a distinct, documented capability.

securityRequirements.defaultPackageModel: Declarative UI/assets plus allowlisted launcher APIs; do not execute arbitrary downloaded bytecode, native libraries, shell scripts or APKs.
